list-feedback.name: list-feedback
list-feedback.description: List all feedback reports from users. Filter by lifecycle view (tracking/future/dismissed/completed/all) or by exact type, status, priority, and user.

params.view: Lifecycle view (optional): tracking = open/in_review/in_progress, future = postponed, dismissed, completed = resolved. Wins over status.

get-feedback.name: get-feedback
get-feedback.description: Get full details of a specific feedback report

create-feedback.name: create-feedback
create-feedback.description: Register a bug report or suggestion that arrived OUTSIDE the feedback tool — e.g. mentioned in a conversation, an email, or word of mouth — so that triage has ONE inbox. Use source to record where it came from.

params.title: Short summary
params.description: Detailed description, steps to reproduce, context
params.reportedBy: User ID of the person who reported it (or a placeholder like user_external)
params.source: Where the report came from (default: manual)

update-status.name: update-status
update-status.description: Update the status of a feedback report. Dismissing REQUIRES a dismissReason ('wont_fix' = valid but we won't do it, 'invalid' = not a real bug). Resolving emails the reporter unless notifyReporter is false.

params.status: New status. postponed parks it on the Future list; resolved marks it Completed and emails the reporter.
params.dismissReason: Required when status is 'dismissed': wont_fix (product decision) or invalid (not a real bug)
params.notifyReporter: When resolving: email the reporter that their item is done (default true)
params.message: Optional message to include with the status change (will be visible to user)

set-priority.name: set-priority
set-priority.description: Set or update the priority of a feedback report

add-update.name: add-update
add-update.description: Add an update or comment to a feedback report. This will be visible to the user who submitted it.

params.message: The update message for the user

name: Feedback Admin
description: Manage user feedback: review bug reports and suggestions, update status, set priorities, and communicate updates to users.

changelog.notes: Initial release — review user bug reports and suggestions, set status and priority, and reply with updates
